classification.difficultyReason: Choose a readable point on each gridded line, calculate rise over run and interpret the result as speed or litres added per minute.

content.prompt: Calculate the gradient of each line graph then describe what it represents.

spec.description: Tall narrow rectangular grid with positive axis arrows. Horizontal grid spacing is 0.5 hours; vertical grid spacing is 10 km. The line is clipped at the top boundary.
spec.mathematics: Grid bounds: 0 ≤ t ≤ 1.5 and 0 ≤ d ≤ 110. The line is d = 90t, passing through (0,0) and (1,90). Only 0 and 1 are labelled horizontally; 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 are labelled vertically.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph is a permanent student given. The supplied answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{90}{1}\\m&=90\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$
The distance increases by 90 km each hour, so the speed is 90 km/h.

spec.description: Rectangular coordinate grid with positive axis arrows. Horizontal grid spacing is 0.5 minutes; vertical grid spacing is 10 litres.
spec.mathematics: Grid bounds: 0 ≤ t ≤ 4.5 and 0 ≤ V ≤ 90. The line is V = 15t, passing through (0,0) and (4,60), and ending at (4.5,67.5). Horizontal labels are 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4; vertical labels are 20, 40, 60 and 80.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph is a permanent student given. The supplied answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{60}{4}\\m&=15\text{ L/min}\end{align*}$$
The volume increases by 15 litres each minute.
